evidence: Vary the byte returned by the real MOVX at 08E5 and observe its lifetime through the three recorded caller continuations.
limitations: Local callers, timer byte and receive completions use the declared synthetic fixture; interrupts are disabled.
Only the three observed direct callers are tested; unseen indirect entry paths are not excluded.
The read callback supplies a byte but no external device side effect. Ignoring the byte does not imply that the read bus cycle is unnecessary.
P2 latch addressing is modeled as in the existing controller harness; physical address decoding is untraced.
